LZ4 is an extremely fast compression algorithm focused on compression and decompression speed.

Key features:
1. Ultra-fast decompression (~5 GB/s)
2. High compression speed (~780 MB/s)
3. Two modes: fast mode and high compression mode
4. Widely used in real-time data processing
